description: This file declares the UserIdManager class, which manages user IDs and group IDs for applications within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It provides methods to retrieve user IDs, clear user IDs, and get application GIDs, along with private members for UID range management and synchronization.

classes.name: UserIdManager
classes.description: Manages user IDs and group IDs for applications, providing methods to access and clear user IDs, and retrieve application GID.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with a given application ID.

methods.name: clearUserId
methods.description: Clears the stored user ID for a specified application ID.

methods.name: getAppsUidRange
methods.description: Private method to get the range of valid UIDs for applications.
